title: Serialize and Deserialize Binary Tree
description: Design an algorithm to serialize a binary tree to a string and deserialize that string back to the identical tree structure.

reference.use_case: Converting an in-memory tree into a string or byte stream so it can be stored, cached, or sent over the network and rebuilt exactly.
system_examples: JSON and Protocol Buffers — encoding nested object trees for APIs, RPC, and storage
React Server Components — the server serializes the rendered component tree into a payload the client reconstructs
PostgreSQL — stores view and rule parse trees as text (nodeToString) in pg_rewrite and reads them back
reference.explanation: A preorder traversal that writes explicit null markers yields an unambiguous encoding that one recursive pass can rebuild, O(n) both ways. Capturing structure, not just values, is the central concern of every serialization format.
